rule: Protocol section 11: candidates = union of candidate-positive cases across the workflows actually compared (SEQ only here; neither BATCH comparator was triggered). A candidate is a case the classifier reads as absent at the A-parent and present at the child. Each candidate is then classified as confirmed relapse / residual parent content / final classifier false positive / ambiguous, requiring BOTH parent absence and final presence for confirmation.
